description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two metrics: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. The y-axis on the left measures Perplexity, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, while the y-axis on the right measures the GPU Memory Ratio, ranging from 40% to 100%. The Perplexity is represented by an orange line with circle markers and a solid line style, showing a general decrease as the recent sequence ratio increases, with a notable peak at around 60% sequence ratio. The GPU Memory Ratio is depicted by a blue line with square markers and a dashed line style, which increases sharply as the recent sequence ratio increases, reaching its peak at 100% sequence ratio. The plot also includes two horizontal dashed lines, one for Full Cache PPL and one for Full Cache GPU Mem., indicating constant values across the sequence ratio range.
